headline: Executive order creates a Federal Privacy Council within the executive branch.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group called the Federal Privacy Council. Based on the title, the council deals with how federal agencies handle privacy. No summary was provided, so details on its members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies take part in or work with a new council focused on privacy.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 2016; no separate effective date was provided.
